title: Looking after pets
examples: What kind of food should I give my puppy?
How much exercise does a cat really need?
Is a cage enough for a hamster's home?

explain.say: A pet needs special food to grow big and strong.
Every pet must always have fresh, clean water to drink.
A pet needs a safe and comfortable place to sleep in.
Pets need time outside to run and play every day.

draw.text: Exercise: Time to run and play.

explain.say: Pets need lots of love and gentle playtime from us.
When we look after pets, we keep them healthy and happy.

draw.text: Real Life: Caring for a pet.

faq.q: Do I have to feed my pet special food?
faq.a: Yes, pets need food that is right for their kind and age. You should ask a grown-up or a vet about the best food.
asks: What kind of food is best for dogs?
Does every pet eat the same food?

faq.q: How often should I clean my pet's home?
faq.a: You should clean their home often to keep it fresh and safe for them. A clean home stops yucky germs from growing.
asks: How often do I clean a cage?
Is cleaning the same as washing?

faq.q: What if my pet does not want to play?
faq.a: Sometimes pets need rest time, which is okay. You can still give them gentle attention and love even if they are sleepy.
asks: Is it okay to let my pet sleep a lot?
What if my pet is grumpy?

faq.q: Do I need to take my pet to the doctor?
faq.a: Yes, pets need regular check-ups with a veterinarian. This helps keep them healthy for a long time.
asks: Do pets go to the doctor?
When should I see the vet?

faq.q: Is love enough to keep a pet happy?
faq.a: No, love is very important, but pets also need good food, fresh water, and enough exercise. All these things work together.
asks: Can I just play with my pet?

facts: Dogs need walks for exercise every day.
Cats need clean litter boxes for their home.
All pets need fresh water available at all times.
A balanced diet means getting different kinds of nutrients.

quiz.say: A pet needs a special bowl for:
quiz.why: Water is essential for all living things to stay alive and healthy.

wrong.1: Food gives energy, but water keeps the body working.
wrong.2: Play is fun, but it does not replace the need for drinking water.
wrong.3: Sleep is rest, but water is needed while you are awake.

quiz.say: If a pet does not get enough exercise, what might happen?

options.show: It will only need more toys.
options.say: It will only need more toys.

options.show: It might become lazy and unhappy.
options.say: It might become lazy and unhappy.

quiz.why: Movement helps pets stay strong and keeps them feeling joyful.

wrong.0: Eating more does not replace the need for physical activity.
wrong.1: While sleep is good, too much rest means no fun running around.
wrong.2: Toys are fun, but they cannot replace the need for running in the real world.

quiz.say: Which three things are the most important for a pet's daily care?
quiz.why: These three things are the basic needs for survival and good health.

wrong.1: Love is vital, but it cannot replace the physical need for water.
wrong.2: These are nice things, but they do not give the pet energy to run.
wrong.3: Cuddles are lovely, but a pet still needs to move its body.
